summary: Ash Kalra coauthored California SCR 105, a resolution calling for the end of the humanitarian crisis in Gaza and the immediate release of all hostages.
quote: calls for the end to the humanitarian crisis in Gaza. It demands the immediate release of all hostages and seeks to address the ongoing humanitarian situation in the region.

summary: Kalra posted on X drawing a direct parallel between LA wildfire-displaced residents and Palestinians, urging empathy for both groups.
quote: Please have empathy for displaced people whether they're in the Palisades or Palestine.

summary: CalMatters lists Ash Kalra as listed under Abstain (no Aye/No recorded; reason unspecified) on AB 715 (Assembly Floor). The bill creates an antisemitism coordinator and classroom-material oversight; its text does not explicitly name IHRA.
date_note: CalMatters structured VoteAction date/labels, not an independently verified official roll call; quote is field transcription.

summary: Kalra — the only South Asian American on Assembly Judiciary — publicly challenged SB 403 author Wahab on why the word caste was needed (echoing Hindu American Foundation objections), then voted aye in committee and on final passage.
quote: CA Asm. Ash Kalra on why he's supporting SB 403... He asked the author of SB 403, State Senator Wahab why there's a need to use the term caste in the bill.
